overview: AssamRoots is an Assamese-first commerce platform connecting the Assamese diaspora worldwide with authentic products from Assam. Features a full product catalog organized by category and sub-category, location-aware checkout disclaimers, and a Coming Soon services page targeted at residents inside Assam.
features: 15 product categories with full sub-category navigation
Location-aware disclaimer banner at checkout (India vs Abroad)
Assam-only Services Coming Soon page with 10 teaser cards
Product discovery with search, filters, and category tiles
Cart, checkout, and Stripe payment integration
Order tracking and admin discount management
